reply.text:
Being scared of a food group is worth taking seriously, and cutting carbs out entirely because of fear is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian. They can look at what's going on and help you eat in a way that feels safe. I'm not going to build workouts around a no-carb plan, since training hard on very little fuel works against you.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to build your training with you. Until then, I'm here for any questions about the lifting and running side.
